For members, organizations and sponsors

Trail programs

Three ways to put a trail on the map. Members are always free.

Member · free

Member trails

For anyone who joins the Local Legends Map.

Free with membership
  • Build and publish your own trails
  • Built-in trail check keeps it reasonable
  • Share with other seekers, collect votes
  • Earn Miles toward Trail Blazer status
  • Top-voted trails get featured
Organization

Organization trails

For chambers, BIDs, tourism boards, CVBs, festivals, nonprofits and food tour companies.

CommunityNonprofits and small organizations
  • Verified "Local organizer" badge
  • Up to 3 trails
  • Event dates and a link to your site
Regional PartnerTourism boards, CVBs and larger organizations
  • Everything in Community
  • Unlimited trails, your logo on each
  • Featured on your region's pages
  • Printable passports and QR codes for every stop
  • Trail stats: views, follows and stamps
  • A seasonal challenge each year
Official

Official sponsored trails

For brands, businesses and tourism boards that want to present a Local Legends Map trail.

Stop SponsorA business already on an official trail
  • Photos and hours on its stop
  • A perk for passport holders
  • "Stop sponsor" tag
Presenting SponsorOne per trail
  • "Presented by" name and logo on the trail page, cards and passport
  • A mention in the news ticker
Title SponsorOne per trail per season
  • Everything in Presenting
  • Newsletter and social feature
  • A sponsored challenge with a prize
  • Co-branded printed passport

How we keep trails honest

  • Money never picks the stops. The Local Legends Map chooses the stops on official trails. Sponsors present a trail; they don't buy their way onto it.
  • Sponsorship is always labeled. "Presented by," "Title sponsor" and "Stop sponsor" are shown wherever they apply.
  • Everyone follows the trail guide. Organization and member trails get the same trail check: reasonable stops, reasonable time.
  • Members vote on everything. Official, organization and member trails all compete in the same Top trails ranking.
